tools.name: trial_register_protocol
tools.description: Register a hash-bound trial protocol; twins fork from the identical checkpoint, exactly one registered variable may differ.

tools.name: trial_fork_pair
tools.description: Fork a checkpoint-paired assignment for one task (blinded arms A/B).

tools.name: trial_run_pair
tools.description: Run one pair with the deterministic scripted agent and score blind. $0.25/pair, first 10 free once per operator.

tools.name: trial_submit_outputs
tools.description: Submit the operator twins' outputs for one pair; blinded deterministic scoring. $0.25/pair, first 10 free once per operator.

tools.name: trial_verdict
tools.description: Trial verdict under the enforced stopping rule.

tools.name: trial_unblind
tools.description: Unblind after the verdict; hashed signed receipt covering every pair.
